users: data-center practitioners and researchers comparing declared cooling scenarios
supported_tasks: export governed study inputs and reports
not_intended_for: an ISO-conformant comparative LCA or a facility-specific decision without suitable foreground data, inventories, uncertainty analysis, system boundaries, and critical review

required_inputs: site, cooling, electricity, water, and equipment assumptions

limitations: Passing the automated audit is not an ISO conformity assessment.
Result strength depends on declared foreground data, background inventories, uncertainty, system boundaries, and critical review.
